android.tokens: DESIGN.md frontmatter owns primitives; this sidecar adds native behavior without duplicating them.
android.theme: System light/dark; static Material 3 schemes, no Dynamic Color. Unassigned roles/type/shape/elevation retain library defaults; platform window theme retains light defaults.

widgetColorRoles.dark: ink/muted/primary from dark tokens; dedicated widget-dark-bg and widget-dark-button

android.typeHierarchy: displaySmall: arrival; headlineLarge: first use; headlineMedium: route/settings; headlineSmall: station; titleLarge/Medium: card/state/section/plate; bodyLarge/Medium/Small: station/copy/time; labelLarge: selected stop. System fonts and sp scaling.
android.nativeControls: Material 3 TopAppBar, NavigationBar, buttons, FilterChip, OutlinedTextField, ListItem, progress, cards, Surface, AlertDialog and SnackbarHost; detail/picker BackHandler. No expanded-width rail/drawer.
android.signature: Station-sequence diagram; unique vehicle stop matches only, ambiguous reports remain uncertain; no GPS/speed/reliable ETA.
android.widgetCapacity: Minimum resize 160x220dp; scale=max(font,1); compact=width<240 or height<260; rowHeight=(large and not compact?88:64)*scale; reserved=56*scale+72; rows=min(max(truncate((height-reserved)/rowHeight),0),small or compact?1:medium?2:3).
android.zeroRows: Header/time/controls only, no empty prompt. Header opens active route detail when available, otherwise selection; timestamp falls back to active snapshot.
android.compact: Hide position/plate/next; medium with two rows also hides position. Plate only on noncompact large; next needs another arrival and spare height>24*scale. Reverse hidden below 240dp; ride shortened below 280dp or font>1.2; refresh always 刷新.
android.freshness: fetchedAt is local successful query time. App stale on failure, nonpositive timestamp, rollback or age>90s; cached data survives failure. Arrival-card stamp suffix checks age only; compact-card uses full predicate.
android.widgetSnapshot: Observation headline always 上次, with actual oldest displayed query timestamp or active fallback. Headline/time/stale suffix only update on render; zero-row failure check still uses empty displayed list.
android.chronometer: Native elapsedRealtime()-max(now-oldest,0), 已过 %s; positive timestamp and font<1.5 only. Locally elapsed age, not a fetch or freshness guarantee.
android.runtime: Foreground/waiting target 15s, waiting max 15min with notification/Stop; ordinary network-constrained JobScheduler target 15min, widget updatePeriodMillis=0. Android/Xiaomi can delay. WeChat launch only.

verification.reported: Signed release built; 18 unit tests passed; debug/release lint 0 errors; 3 review findings closed. Not rerun for documentation.
verification.unverified: Xiaomi 15 interaction, themes/system bars, font scaling/resizing, Back, notifications, WeChat and background networking
verification.detector: Not applicable: native Android; no HTML/CSS previews

narrative.overview: Code-derived existing native system; preview with explicit verification gap. No new aesthetic direction.
dos: Preserve native controls and system font scaling
Preserve query time, historical language and zero-row fallback
donts: Do not imply real GPS/ETA or guaranteed background cadence
